page.layout: One printed title page, one block of text across the full width. The scan is cut off at the right and lower part; the printed lines run into the cut. Show-through from the other side of the leaf (mirrored text) and handwritten marks are present and are not transcribed.; One printed title page, one block of centred lines. The lines are set in large bold type in the middle, with a small imprint at the foot. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side runs across the upper and middle lines and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Most of the title is badly damaged and blurred; many lines are only partly legible and are marked as illegible. The lower lines appear mirrored (show-through from the reverse) and are not transcribed as printed text. Handwriting in the upper left and an ink stroke across the top are excluded. Readings marked [?] are uncertain. Show-through: mirrored text from the reverse side (EVANGELIUM, Secundum Matthaeum, Ex Ipsius Scripturarum, HEBRAEO, RITIBUS & IDIOMATIS, Veterum recentiorum, and Greek and Latin lines in the middle and lower left) is not transcribed. Handwritten figures (888.04) are not transcribed. The imprint and the lines beside Jane R. P. D. are only partly legible on the scan, so most of their wording is marked illegible rather than guessed. The right-hand edge carries a fragment of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.
